best_measured_official.hypothesis: The top offline seeker candidate must be measured on the real official 8xH100 / 600s budget before trusting any further sp1024 search.
best_measured_official.config: Official fineweb10B_sp1024, 8xH100, 10x512 KV2, seq=896, train_batch_tokens=573,440, GRAD_ACCUM_STEPS=1, Muon 0.97, MAX_WALLCLOCK_SECONDS=600, export=int8_attnhi.
best_measured_official.conclusion: First completed official 8xH100 seeker run. Much stronger than the 1xH100 probe, but still far from 1.1 and it left about 171s of the official wallclock budget unused because ITERATIONS=2500 was too low.

best_measured_local.hypothesis: A targeted Fisher- and KL-guided LFQAT phase on the legal fc_hi + proj_hi export family can beat both raw continuation and earlier post-hoc-only legalizers.
best_measured_local.config: Start from 12x608 raw adapt150, 60 steps, constant low LR (0.004/0.003/0.003), TRAIN_QAT=fc_hi+proj_hi, TRAIN_COMPRESSION_AWARE_WEIGHT=0.0015, LFQAT_KL_WEIGHT=0.05, LFQAT_FISHER_WEIGHT=0.01, ramp qat_prob=0.15->1.0 by step 30.
best_measured_local.conclusion: New best legal 262k local result. Beats the previous 12x608 legal leader by 0.0307 bpb and is the first local run under 1.99 in this dense line.
